data.line: I am so mad, and this is exactly why you read the reviews before you buy another foundation. Because I bought this FACELOVE stick that everyone would not stop raving about, and I am going to be returning it.
data.prompt:
[slowly] [annoyed] I am SO mad, and this is exactly why you read the reviews before you buy another foundation. [pause] Because I bought this FACELOVE stick that everyone would not stop raving about... and I am going to be RETURNING it. [pause]

[slowly] [deadpan] And it is not because it goes on pure white and then turns into my EXACT shade and melts in like it was made for my skin. [pause] [scoffs] Even the woman at the makeup counter told me my redness was too tricky to match and I should not bother. [pause]

[slowly] It is not because it covered the redness, the hyperpigmentation, the old post-acne marks, and every tired line and dark circle I have been hiding for YEARS, in one swipe. [pause] [sarcastic] And it is DEFINITELY not because three of my friends this week asked what I am using, because my skin looks so even. [pause]

[slowly] It is not because I can FINALLY skip a full face of makeup, throw this one stick on before the grocery store, and feel completely confident walking out the door. [pause]

[slowly] [firm] No. [pause] I am returning this one, because after I bought it, I found out it is the LAST day of the Prime Sale. [pause] [excited] Sixty percent off. [pause] Two full Foundation Sticks for almost the price of one, plus a free primer, a mystery gift, free shipping, and a full thirty day money back guarantee. [pause] [chuckles] So I am sending back my one, and buying the deal like I should have. [pause]

[slowly] [serious] So do not do what I did and pay for one. [pause] If you have not tried this yet, tap the link and grab the deal before midnight, because once the Prime Sale ends tonight, it is GONE. [pause] [warm] It was never your skin. [pause] It was the formula.
